verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs show passkey-anchored step-up authentication, mandate-based spend caps with decline thresholds and consumerPrompt consent text, per-instruction credential requests scoped to merchant/amount, and cryptographically signed agent authorization (TAP) validated against the user's authenticated instruction before authorization — covering confirmation, mandate, and per-purchase consent mechanisms. Community commentary raises skepticism about maturity/identity standards but does not concretely contradict the documented approval flow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that the passkey/mandate flow works end-to-end in production rather than sandbox/spec-stage.
